title.narrative: Program to Promote Fiscal Sustainability and Enhance the Effectiveness of Public Expenditure in the Municpio of Recife
Programa de Promocin de la Sostenibilidad Fiscal y Mejora de la Efectividad del Gasto Pblico del Municipio de Recife

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo del programa es contribuir al logro del equilibrio fiscal del Municipio de Recife. Los objetivos de desarrollo especficos son: (i) aumentar la efectividad de la recaudacin tributaria; y (ii) aumentar la eficiencia del gasto pblico.

The general development objective of the program is to contribute to achieving fiscal balance in the Municipality of Recife. The specific development objectives are: (i) increase the effectiveness of tax collection; and (ii) increase the efficiency of public spending.
